crossRefs.note: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the…
For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
‘Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe…
knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

translations.web: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
translations.bsb: Judgments are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
translations.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
translations.asv: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And stripes for the back of fools.
